items.title: Mask My File — Black out data before sharing | iOS App
items.content_html:
Share safely without losing the context people genuinely need. Mask My File finds private details before you send a file, permanently hides only what you choose, then reopens and verifies the new copy before it shows Private Ready. USE IT WHEN IT MATTERS Before you send a tenancy application, an NHS letter, a payslip showing your National Insurance number, or a client file to a colleague, keep the useful context while permanently hiding the details they do not need. Originals are never overwritten; temporary workspace files, Private Session data and projects stay on the device until you delete them. BUY ONCE. USE IT FOR LIFE.
